attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Fixes a bug where Convert.ToString was called on the TagHelperAttribute object instead of its Value (previously always returning the type name string), so behavior changes from broken to correct but affects widely-used shape tag helper attribute parsing across all views using these attributes."}

reason: Fixes a bug where Convert.ToString was called on the TagHelperAttribute object instead of its Value (previously always returning the type name string), so behavior changes from broken to correct but affects widely-used shape tag helper attribute parsing across all views using these attributes.
